description: Slamtec RPLIDAR C1 on the companion computer (USB serial, 460800 baud): a planar 360 degree scanner, 0.05-12 m, 10 Hz, 0.72 degree angular resolution (5000 samples/s), +-30 mm range accuracy. T_body_sensor is a default (FLU, scan plane level, +x forward, mast 0.12 m above the CG): measure the mount and update the translation. blocked_azimuth_deg lists the sectors the airframe occludes; it starts empty.
